standards_review.notes: all 3 commit subjects in d563dc5..HEAD match the documented EPMCDME-####: Description format (git-workflow.md Commit Message Format)

new src/codemie/core/search_ranking.py carries the Apache 2.0 header, from __future__ import annotations, explicit parameter/return types with X | None and parameterized generics, and is a dedicated module for the new concern per Module Cohesion; edits to the large ai_kata_repository.py, skill_repository.py and workflow.py are import-and-call wiring only, not a new concern appended; new test file has the license header; changed lines are within the 120-char Ruff line-length (pyproject.toml:219); Ruff itself was not run (read-only audit)

no auth, role-helper or secret-handling code touched and no logging added; search filters remain SQLAlchemy-parameterized ilike expressions and now pass user text through escape_like_wildcards (escapes backslash, % and _) with escape='\\', tightening the previously unescaped patterns in user_preferences_service.py and ai_kata_repository.py; no lossy normalization of untrusted input before a security decision
